report_comment.text: FGFR1 encodes a fibroblast growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase. TACC1 encodes transforming acidic coiled-coil-containing protein 1. The fusion retains the FGFR kinase domain and the TACC coiled-coil region, promoting constitutive kinase activity and abnormal mitotic-spindle function. Transforming activity has been demonstrated in glioma models. FGFR inhibition has shown activity in experimental fusion-positive glioma models; this preclinical evidence does not establish an approved glioma indication.
